sourceEvidence.text: Arc A Rekindling StarsHook one of the new constellations above Yieldheart flickers out nightly. Investigation reveals stray Null fragment shapes star energy into weaponized silence. Party must recover fragments before dawn of Equinox.

changes.before: One of the new constellations above post-epilogue Yieldheart dims nightly. Three finite stray Null fragments in local instruments redirect its light into soundless weapons.
changes.after: One of the new constellations above post-epilogue Yieldheart flickers out nightly, preserving the original hook. The NEW local adaptation places three finite stray Null fragments in instruments that redirect star energy into weaponized silence. Their exact relationship to the reviewed residual-Null and relic procedures remains for joint integration.

changes.before: Two ARC-HUSH-DRONEs at the bench; hostile only when a creature touches the lens or attacks a spindle. Each has its own38HP. Persistent salvage IDs are A1-SPINDLE-1 and A1-SPINDLE-2.
changes.after: Two ARC-HUSH-DRONEs at the bench; hostile only when a creature touches the lens or attacks a spindle. Each has its own38HP. Persistent salvage IDs are A1-SPINDLE-1 and A1-SPINDLE-2. When an actor first attempts to touch or manipulate the lens assembly (including either service control), or attacks a spindle, begin ordinary initiative before resolving that hostile interaction. Venting is an actual Action on the actor’s turn; rotating the inner ring is another actual Action. No free pre-initiative vent or automatic uninterrupted pair is granted. Use actual positions, initiative, legal extra Actions and attacks; control completion powers off the extant spindles immediately. They do not attack after being powered off.

changes.before: One Action within5ft opens labeled vent; next Action rotates inner ring and powers off both extant spindles. No roll if this sequence is followed; manipulating inner ring first deals2d6force to the operator, warns visibly, then leaves state unchanged. Other legal methods use real damage/abilities.
changes.after: One Action within5ft opens labeled vent; next Action rotates inner ring and powers off both extant spindles. No roll if this sequence is followed; manipulating inner ring first deals2d6force to the operator, warns visibly, then leaves state unchanged. Other legal methods use real damage/abilities. The visible vent and ring are both accessible within 5 ft of the lens assembly. Their labels provide the correct order, but do not suppress the stated hostility trigger. Before a player commits, describe the spindles turning toward any hand approaching those controls. Retreat through the actual south entrance remains possible; the spindles do not pursue beyond it.

changes.before: Maintenance log explicitly confirms fragments moved into instruments after the constellation first dimmed. It names no cosmic identity or Equation.
changes.after: Maintenance log explicitly confirms fragments moved into instruments after the constellation first began flickering out. It names no cosmic identity or Equation.

Neither blade nor corpse grants infernal office, patents or bound souls.
changes.after: Body 160 lb; mundane blade 3 lb, common clothes 3 lb, one 0.02 lb contract master, twelve 0.02 lb blank receipt sheets and the one exercise purse (0.1 lb empty plus its original twenty-five gold coins, 0.5 lb). Receipt sheets are separate from press paper. The purse is the same 25 gp promised in the refusal exercise, not an additional treasure. Neither blade nor corpse grants infernal office, patents or bound souls. The three reusable discussion slips are additional actual paper, 0.02 lb each. They cannot be replenished by restarting the exercise; a witnessed oral choice can substitute if the tokens are unavailable.

changes.before: Each actual cell activation consumes that one cell’s use immediately, successful or not, supplies at most ten elapsed minutes of drive and can pressurize the sealed chamber only once. Record activatedAt and chargeSpent. Venting or a discharge empties that one charge; closing the vent does not recharge it. Its casing remains. After ten minutes the drive ends; any retained pressure must still be vented before opening. Loading a second cell is a new real activation, not a reset of the first.
changes.after: Each actual cell activation consumes that one cell’s use immediately, successful or not, supplies at most ten elapsed minutes of drive and can pressurize the sealed chamber only once. Record activatedAt and chargeSpent. Venting or a discharge empties that one charge; closing the vent does not recharge it. Its casing remains. After ten minutes the drive ends; any retained pressure must still be vented before opening. Loading a second cell is a new real activation, not a reset of the first. Activation requires the actual cap closed, vent closed and gauge verified at zero. An attempted activation without those prerequisites fails without consuming or resetting a cell; use ordinary Actions and the visible interlock. An intact seal raises gauge to 1. A cracked seal lets that one charge escape and the gauge reaches 0 by the failed sixty-second test. The running drive cannot refill pressure. A wrong route with an intact seal instead leaves gauge 1 with the return vane stopped. Both faults can coexist; the leaking gauge then reaches 0 and the operator must correct both before a passing test.

after.start: T=E−72h; S1 unsealed; both North Observatory spindles active. Known street pace 3 mph.
after.events: Travel 600 seconds from court to the site. Record actual siteElapsedSeconds from entry to exit, including approach, initiative, vent/ring/remove Actions, hostile turns, other abilities and any interruption. On successful recovery, return by the 600-second street; fit and close in two actual Actions (12 seconds), then stabilize for 600 uninterrupted seconds.
after.end: If those actual events succeed, S1 becomes sealed and its one 50 gp claim is earned. The former fixed 1830-second total did not account for hostile initiative and is withdrawn in this proposal, preserved in history. No assumed misses, free enemy turns, extra Actions or resource refresh.
